pages.text: A Fire Apostle follows Serpenperth's envoy and fights for the serpon - an elite, all melee, and every blow carries fire.

This mighty Fire Apostle can only be summoned by ritual - but do not fret: even beaten back it leaves a token (a $(l)Blazing Ember$()) that will call it again, so long as you throw that token into fire.$(br)Only an owned apostle leaves one when it falls, with the apostle itself sealed inside: throw it into fire and the very same one comes back; if no body was sealed in it, a new one grows in the flames.
You can right-click your Serpon Fire Apostle with $(item)Blaze Powder$() or a $(item)Blaze Rod$() to heal it.
